property_summary: For any caller and any new owner, transferOwnership succeeds if and only if the caller is the current owner, and on success owner becomes the new owner; the mutant inverts the access check so the owner's calls revert and non-owners' calls succeed, breaking this for some fuzzed input.
change_summary: Replace the modifier's check 'msg.sender == owner' with 'msg.sender != owner' so only non-owners may call guarded functions.
